findings.claim: People expect 'all remaining markets' to include wstETH, rETH, and weETH; the code leaves those composite-oracle configs commented out for a follow-up.

People expect each oracle config to deploy its own wrapper; the code skips a config when its wrapper name already resolves to a new-style wrapper, so USDC and USDbC share one CHAINLINK_USDC_USD wrapper.
People expect setFeed to be keyed by the config's symbol string; the code instead keys it by whatever ERC20.symbol() returns from the token contract at that address.

People expect the 3000 value in the 70/30 fee split to be the protocol's 70% share or a generic multiplier; the code does pass FEE_MULTIPLIER to setLiquidatorFeeBps, making 3000 bps the liquidator's 30% share.
